BSE India - Corporate Action & Outcome of Board Meeting

Company SymbolRELIANCE
Scrip Code500325
Disseminated Time22-Apr-2024 18:30:00
SubjectOutcome of Board Meeting - Audited Financial Results for FY24 & Dividend Recommendation

Dear Sir/Madam,

We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Reliance Industries Limited at its meeting held today, April 22, 2024, approved the Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2024.

The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 10.00 per equity share of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024, subject to the approval of members at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

Consolidated Net Profit for FY24 stood at INR 69,621 Crores with Revenue from Operations at INR 901,064 Crores.
